$comment: Specs that mutate server-wide state (classification, login/MFA, ToS, upload limits, channel attributes, connected workspaces). Each target gets its own CI shard that runs in parallel with the pool shards. B is used by no pool shard; site3 (iOS only) is also every pool shard's read-only SITE_3, so specs routed there must not change login, ToS, MFA, license or plugins. 'target' applies to every platform; 'iosTarget' overrides it for iOS. Targets: B (server B), site3 (shared SITE_3). Paths are repo-relative; entries not found in the search path are ignored with a warning.
